items.title: ASP.NET anti-CSRFライブラリにCVE-2026-131914
items.author: The Hacker News (@TheHackersNews)
items.summary: Hackers are actively exploiting a critical flaw in a legacy ASP .NET anti-CSRF library to take over web servers. CVE-2026-131914 (CVSS 9.3). No login required. Just ONE HTTP POST request. No official patch. The vulnerable library hasn't been updated since 2008.
items.quote: 🚨 Hackers are actively exploiting a critical flaw in a legacy ASP .NET anti-CSRF library to take over web servers.

items.title: SAP NetWeaver CVE-2025-42884が悪用中
items.author: The Hacker News (@TheHackersNews)
items.summary: UPDATE: Hackers are actively exploiting an SAP NetWeaver flaw (CVE-2025-42884) with NO public exploit available. Onapsis confirms the attacks and warns the CVSS 6.5 bug could enable remote code execution and full server compromise. Patch now.
items.quote: 🚨 UPDATE: Hackers are actively exploiting an SAP NetWeaver flaw (CVE-2025-42884) with NO public exploit available.

items.title: GL.iNetルータにクラウド脆弱性悪用
items.author: The Hacker News (@TheHackersNews)
items.summary: WARNING - Hackers exploited a GL.iNet cloud security flaw to install malware on customer routers and KVM devices. The attack involved root-level access, and the cloud-side fix alone won't clean infected devices.
items.quote: ‼️ WARNING - Hackers exploited a GL.iNet cloud security flaw to install malware on customer routers and KVM devices.

items.title: N-able Mail AssureにCVE-2026-134624
items.author: The Hacker News (@TheHackersNews)
items.summary: BREAKING: N-able reveals a critical 9.3-severity flaw in Mail Assure, discovered during an investigation into a breach of its hosted cloud. CVE-2026-134624 could let privileged API users reach internal systems.
items.quote: ‼️ BREAKING: N-able reveals a critical 9.3-severity flaw in Mail Assure, discovered during an investigation into a breach of its hosted cloud.

items.title: ScreenConnectにCVSS 9.9の脆弱性悪用
items.author: The Hacker News (@TheHackersNews)
items.summary: ALERT - Hackers are exploiting a critical ScreenConnect flaw (CVSS 9.9) to hijack MSP technicians' PCs, without a single warning or prompt. One malicious session. Remote access in just 9 seconds. 688,000+ exploit attempts observed.
items.quote: ‼️ ALERT - Hackers are exploiting a critical ScreenConnect flaw (CVSS 9.9) to hijack MSP technicians' PCs, without a single warning or prompt.
